rules.notes: stc Bahrain: recharge vouchers of BD 3 or below grant credit only and add no line validity; cumulative validity is capped at 90 days. A 90-day grace (incoming only, credit retained) is followed by a 30-day disable period. Refills must exceed BD 3 (~USD 13.27) to count.
rules.activity_requirement_note: stc Bahrain: recharge vouchers of BD 3 or below grant credit only and add no line validity; cumulative validity is capped at 90 days. A 90-day grace (incoming only, credit retained) is followed by a 30-day disable period. Refills must exceed BD 3 (~USD 13.27) to count.

rules.notes: Zain Bahrain: vouchers of BD 3 or less provide credit with no validity. Larger vouchers add 1-100 days. Recharging at any stage before the termination stage keeps the line.
rules.activity_requirement_note: Zain Bahrain: vouchers of BD 3 or less provide credit with no validity. Larger vouchers add 1-100 days. Recharging at any stage before the termination stage keeps the line.

rules.notes: Batelco: prepaid numbers follow a validity lifecycle; small refills add little or no validity, and a BD 3 validity voucher adds 30 days without credit. Refills must exceed BD 3 (~USD 13.27) to hold the line.
rules.activity_requirement_note: Batelco: prepaid numbers follow a validity lifecycle; small refills add little or no validity, and a BD 3 validity voucher adds 30 days without credit. Refills must exceed BD 3 (~USD 13.27) to hold the line.

usage_info: PSN (Web):
1. Visit the PlayStation website.
2. Log in to your PSN account.
3. From the top, click on the account profile menu
4. Choose redeem code.
5. Enter your 12-digit code.
6. Click on 'Continue' and the balance will be added to your account.
PSN (Console):
1. Open your console and log in to your PSN account.
2. Go to PlayStation Store.
3. From the top, click on the account profile menu.
4. Choose redeem code.
5. Enter your 12-digit code.
6. Enter your digit code and press 'Redeem'
PS App:
1. Click on the store icon.
2. From the top of the page, click on the menu and choose '(Redeem Code)'.
3. Enter your 12-digit code and press 'Redeem'.
